title: surface_audit.csv ledgers 3 aprender-orchestrate MCP tools (compute, memory, rag) that the binary never serves
evidence: measured 2026-09-27 (c1) on batch/ont-10 @f9b8c773a: rows `mcp:compute|memory|rag (agent tool registry)` cite crates/aprender-orchestrate/src/agent/tool/mcp_server.rs:118/213/285 (`fn name` of the three McpHandler impls). HandlerRegistry has no caller outside src/agent/tool/mcp_server_tests.rs; the only other user is examples/agent_demo.rs. `aprender-orchestrate mcp` (stdio, src/mcp/server.rs) lists hf_info/hf_integration/hf_search/hf_tree only, and banco POST /api/v1/mcp lists calculator/code_execution/web_search. So no transport of the binary exposes compute/memory/rag, and the rows are bin:ledgerOrphan on contracts/bin-aprender-orchestrate--aprender-orchestrate-v1.yaml. A rename or delete is refused by check_dogfood_coverage.sh G2.2 (a vanished row takes its defect with it).
ask: Decide which way the surface goes: (a) serve HandlerRegistry from the binary (register it in `aprender-orchestrate mcp` or banco's ToolRegistry), and the three rows then join tools/list; or (b) the tools are library-only, and the ledger/gate gets a declared library-surface allowance (a G2.2-visible reclassification, not a delete). Until then the RED stands.
